title: 70.3% report career advancement but 46.2% saw no pay increase
summary: 70.3% of designers report career advancement in the past year, with soft skills leading growth: 64.3% increased project influence. However, 46.2% saw no pay increase despite career progress. Career satisfaction clusters in the middle of the scale: 48.2% rate it 4-5, against 19.2% high (6-7) and 32.6% low (1-3).
methodology: Self-reported career progress types, compensation changes, and satisfaction ratings in anonymous online survey
